hero.headline: Sustainable inclusion for every citizen.
hero.subhead: Inspiration is a registered voluntary organization working across health, environment, education, livelihoods, and disaster response — in direct partnership with government health systems, local institutions, and community volunteers.

about.intro: Established in 2013, Inspiration is a non-governmental organization dedicated to empowering marginalised communities through sustainable development initiatives. We work in close collaboration with local communities, government agencies, and fellow NGOs to drive positive change. Our approach emphasises participatory processes — prioritising the needs and voices of vulnerable populations — through community-based services, self-sustainable livelihood opportunities, and people-centred development. We believe true development is achieved only through the active participation of the people themselves: by the people, for the people.
badges: Regd. Office: Chipaha Satra, Titabor, Jorhat

vision: A world where all individuals have equal access to opportunities, resources, and services, enabling them to live with dignity and respect. We envision a future where marginalised communities are empowered to take control of their lives, make informed decisions, and contribute to the development of their communities.
mission: Empowerment For All (EFA): improving the lives of marginalised communities through education, healthcare, and economic empowerment. We strive to provide access to quality education, healthcare services, and economic opportunities — enabling individuals to break the cycle of poverty and achieve their full potential.
objectives: Community Engagement — build trust and partnerships with marginalised communities, understanding their needs and priorities.
Participatory Development — empower communities to take ownership of development initiatives, ensuring sustainability and self-reliance.
Inclusive and Equitable — foster inclusive environments, promoting equal opportunities and social justice for all.
Capacity Building — enhance community capacities through training, education, and skill development.
Resource Mobilization — leverage resources from governments, donors, and private sectors to support community development initiatives.
Education and Skills Development — implement programs focusing on education, vocational training, and livelihood skills.
Health and Well-being — provide access to healthcare services, promote healthy practices, and support mental well-being.
Economic Empowerment — facilitate economic growth through entrepreneurship development, microfinance, and income-generation activities.

programs.title: HIV/AIDS & Public Health
programs.desc: Community-based HIV/AIDS awareness, screening, and mobile health camps run under our Targeted Intervention project (TI Inspiration, Jorhat), in partnership with ASACS and district health authorities.
programs.examples: World AIDS Day camps with ASACS & JDHS Jorhat (2022–24) · Mobile ICTC van camps, Kabuganj · Awareness camps, Borhola & West Titabor · Free health screening camps

programs.title: Disaster Response & Flood Relief
programs.desc: Rapid-response relief coordination for communities across the Brahmaputra floodplain, delivering essential supplies and free health camps through a locally mobilised volunteer network.
programs.examples: Relief convoy, Guwahati → Sivasagar · Free health camps for flood-affected people, Namchungi & Kachajan Tea Estate · Relief kit distribution in flood-hit villages

programs.title: Environment & Natural Resources
programs.desc: Annual World Environment Day plantation drives run with local colleges and schools, part of our broader commitment to conservation and sustainable resource management.
programs.examples: 500 saplings, Nabin Bordoloi College (2024) · 150 saplings, CKB College (2023) · Plantation drive, Mihiram Saikia HS School (2022)

programs.title: Education, Culture & Youth Development
programs.desc: Life-skills and cultural programming for young people — from folk-arts workshops to school-based competitions marking national and cultural observances.
programs.examples: 11-day Bihu Dance Workshop, Assam Bhawan, Kolkata · Children's Day art/quiz/essay competitions · Kati Bihu & All-Assam letter-writing competition

programs.title: Blood Donation & National Observances
programs.desc: Regular blood donation camps and civic participation in national observances, building community trust and engagement around our health programming.
programs.examples: Free blood donation camp, Bihu 2024 · Blood donation & health check-up, New Year 2025 · Independence Day, Republic Day & Gandhi Jyanti observations

programs.title: Workers' Welfare, Women & Social Justice
programs.desc: Solidarity events for informal-sector workers, women's empowerment observances, and youth engagement programs that build community bonds.
programs.examples: May Day with construction & tempo-driver unions · International Women's Day: felicitation & old-age home outreach · World Drug Day awareness, CKB Commerce College

approachSubhead: A multi-state field structure, built to reach the last mile without duplicating the government systems already in place.

approach.title: A pan-India network
approach.desc: Project staff, volunteers, and members based across India, coordinating field operations across Assam and Northeast India — Jorhat, Titabor, Sivasagar, and beyond.

approach.title: Outreach-first
approach.desc: "We prioritise direct, on-the-ground engagement — going to communities rather than expecting them to come to us."

approach.title: Government-linked
approach.desc: Programs run in coordination with ASACS, JDHS, and district health authorities across the Northeast, connecting communities to existing public services.

approach.title: Structured & accountable
approach.desc: A registered executive committee and a rapidly mobilising volunteer network, publishing annual reports each year since 2022–23.

approach.title: Technical guidance
approach.desc: Supported by honorary technical advisors who guides the design, planning, and implementation of our projects and activities.
